page.layout: One printed page, one text block in a single column; a few faint marginal fragments at the far right edge are show-through and are not transcribed. Heading block at top in large display type, dedication title lines and an opening decorated initial, running text below; page number at the foot.

main_text.head: Decem Serenissimorum ac Potentissimorum S. Romani Imperii Archicamerariorum & Principum Electorum Haeredi, FRIDERICI I. ex Burggraviis Noricis, Septemviratus Electoralis Brandenburgici Fundatoris, ejusque ex filio Friderico II. dicto ferrato Nepotis Alberti Achillis Germanici prosapiae Illustrissimae DEFENSORIS Abnepoti Maximo Hujus vero ex filio Joanne Cicerone Germanico, & binis Joachimis Nepotis Joannis Georgii gloriosissimae Marchiacae familiae PROPAGATORIS, Ejusque ex filio primogenito Ioachimo-Friderico Proneposti magno JOANNIS SIGISMVNDI Nepoti proximo GEORGII WILHELMI filio primogenito & successori unico FRIDERICO GVLIELMO
main_text.p: Marchioni Brandenburgio, Borussiae, Cliviae, Juliae, Montium, Stetini, Pomeranorum, Cassubiorum, Vandalorum, Carnoviae & Crosnae, in Silesiâ, Duci, Burggravio Norico, Principi Rugiae, Comiti Marcae & Ravensburgio. Dynastae Ravensteinio, &c. Domino suo Clementissimo, Vita & Incolumitas.

S T.C. de Clivia, Julia, Montia, &c. provinciis amplissimis, quae ob Aviam Illustrissimam Annam Prutenicam ex Matre Maria Eleonora, Gulielmi Abavi, Potentissimi Cliviae, Juliae, Montium &c. Ducis, primogenita, ipsam quoque primogenitam ad C. T. domum Electoralem pervenerunt, & cogitare & loqui saepius

page.notes: The opening initial S is a large woodcut letter. The first lines of the dedication are in italic and roman display type; the mark (?) at the foot beside the page number is uncertain. Right-edge marginal traces are show-through and were omitted.
